Swift Concurrency — Master Async/Await, Tasks, and Structured Concurrency

Master Swift Concurrency once and for all.
This playlist takes you from async/await fundamentals to advanced techniques like structured concurrency, TaskGroup, and MainActor usage — helping you write faster, safer, and more maintainable async code in your iOS apps.

⸻

💡 Why This Playlist Exists

Async/await and Swift Concurrency are among the most powerful but misunderstood additions to Swift.
If you’ve ever run into issues like:
	•	Tasks not executing in the order you expect
	•	UI freezes from unstructured concurrency
	•	Crashes caused by missing await calls
	•	Confusion over MainActor and global actors
…then this playlist is made for you.

Each video breaks down real-world examples, so you can confidently adopt concurrency in both SwiftUI and UIKit projects.

⸻

🧭 What You’ll Learn
	•	How async/await really works under the hood
	•	Structured vs. unstructured concurrency
	•	Avoiding async/await mistakes that cause bugs or memory leaks
	•	Using Task, TaskGroup, and async let effectively
	•	How to convert completion handlers to async/await
	•	Debugging concurrency and understanding task cancellation
	•	Managing MainActor and background thread execution
	•	Writing testable and maintainable concurrent Swift code

⸻

I’m Antoine van der Lee — iOS/macOS Engineer, creator of SwiftLee, and founder of the Swift Concurrency Playbook, a free 5-day email course designed to help you master async/await with clarity.

Through my blog, courses, and talks at international conferences, I’ve helped thousands of developers improve their Swift skills and ship better apps.
